name: Messenger from Dark Night
original_name: メッセンジャー フロム ダークナイト
source:
Hero is half-demon who has his demon part "dark night" awake every evening. Such person transfers to a new school that accepts half-humans as students.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.nl/2017/07/vn-of-month-november-1995.html]vndbreview[/url]]
